description: >
  The Real Sociedad Española de Química has awarded Marc Garcia-Borràs its

---

Marc Garcia-Borràs has been awarded the **Young Investigator Prize** of the Real
Sociedad Española de Química (RSEQ), in the Group Leader category.

The prize follows earlier recognition including the RSEQ–Lilly Early Career
Researcher award in 2024 and the SCQ Emerging Scientific Talent award in 2025.
